name: Camera Battery
description: Guidelines for traveling with camera battery in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Spare rechargeable lithium camera batteries must be carried in carry-on baggage only. Protecting terminal contacts (with tape or plastic caps) is recommended.

checkedBag.reason: Spare lithium camera batteries are prohibited in checked baggage holds due to fire risk.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring camera battery on a plane?

travelTips: Spare rechargeable lithium camera batteries must be carried in carry-on baggage only. Protecting terminal contacts (with tape or plastic caps) is recommended.

faq.question: Is camera battery allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Camera Battery is allowed in carry-on luggage. Spare rechargeable lithium camera batteries must be carried in carry-on baggage only. Protecting terminal contacts (with tape or plastic caps) is recommended.

faq.question: Can you pack camera battery in checked baggage?
faq.answer: No, Camera Battery is not allowed in checked bags. Spare lithium camera batteries are prohibited in checked baggage holds due to fire risk.
